propositions: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket signatures omit force, reason, caused_by, and ref parameters that are already supported by the library and CLI, making those features unreachable over MCP.

FastMCP derives JSON schemas from handwritten callable signatures and discards undeclared payload keys before the adapter runs, and the adapter forwarding layer independently omits the same parameters, creating a dual barrier.
The MCP write adapter must expose and forward all supported library parameters unchanged (transition force/reason/caused_by/ref, claim force) to reach the shared library core.
MCP ref and caused_by must produce identical behavior to the library: ref targeting and signing the requested immutable commit rather than HEAD, caused_by writing the culprit edge correctly.

Absent force and missing required close reason must remain rejected as before; force_close and a distinct close-reason field must remain unavailable over MCP; the operator ruling establishes absent certification as the audit signal for force.
